title: Count Orders by Hour of Day
description: Analyze order timing by grouping orders by the **hour of day** (0–23) in which they were placed. Show the hour and the number of orders placed during that hour, ordered from earliest to latest hour.
solution_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM order_timestamp) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM order_timestamp) ORDER BY hour_of_day
hints: Use EXTRACT(HOUR FROM order_timestamp) to pull the hour component (an integer 0–23) from each timestamp.
Group by the same EXTRACT expression and count rows — hours with no orders simply won't appear in the result.
explanation: EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ...) returns the hour component (0–23) of a timestamp. Grouping by this value produces an order frequency distribution by hour. From the data: hour 8 has orders 1, 2, 12 (=3); hour 9 has order 5 (=1); hour 12 has orders 3, 4 (=2); hour 14 has orders 6, 7, 8 (=3); hour 18 has order 9 (=1); hour 20 has orders 10, 11 (=2). Only 6 distinct hours appear.
